parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The customer order id (aggregate root id, CloudEvents subject).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated UUID per logical submit, 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters (missing is 400 idempotency-key-required, malformed is 400 idempotency-key-invalid). A key is global and kept for 24 hours. An answer is stored only when it is final for the request: a success, and a refusal whose problem type is FINAL or OUTCOME (ADR 0019). The same key with the same method, path and body replays a stored answer with Idempotency-Replayed: true; the same key with anything else is 409 idempotency-key-reused. A refusal that depends on state that can change is not stored and releases the key, so the same request under the same key runs again, and another request under that key is a new request. These problem types are not stored: not-found, concurrent-update, illegal-transition, cancel-after-lock, validation-failed, promise-capacity-exhausted, book-closed, group-spans-nodes, promise-destination-mismatch and delivery-promise-unavailable (retry with the same key). The others are stored: malformed-request, line-without-promise, status-regression, shopper-exists, too-many-addresses and offer-not-quotable (use a new key). A 5xx and a panic are never stored.
